audit.corrected: Moved full phases[0,2,3,4,5,6].side to match content win[N] (row1 already agrees, left alone), and rewrote all seven .why lines to state the actual reason for each stage, grounded in Ebb and Flow poke early, the level-2 skill check on Aqua Prison, Leona's kill window levels 3-5, the Solar Flare vs Tidal Wave ult race, and Nami's late kiting.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are copy-paste bleeds from tradeGood/tradeBad, report[8].t and report[9].t misgender Nami as 'his'/'him', and missingInteractions flags anti-heal timing against Ebb and Flow sustain that the page doesn't state anywhere.
audit.why: Nami is she/her; the cooldowns field needs a real number to be useful for cooldown-tracking; and without an anti-heal callout the reader has no concrete counter to her W sustain in extended trades.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with real numbers (Aqua Prison 12-8s, Tidal Wave 120/110/100s, Ebb and Flow 10s) and an anti-heal line, fixed dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d to state the bubble/ult-bait interactions instead of generic trade text, and corrected the two misgendered pronouns.

edits.before: Auto-trade behind passive marks — your carry's follow-up hits harder than the lane reads.
edits.after: Her Ebb and Flow heal-poke out-trades you before your E is online — respect her range.

edits.before: E-Q online — the chain is live and the lane's geometry answers to your blade.
edits.after: E-Q all-in beats her, but a landed Aqua Prison bubble stops it cold — skill decides.

edits.before: Full chain: E-Q-W locks a carry for the full duo rotation; pick the window.
edits.after: Your engage into stun kills a squishy enchanter with no hard self-peel.

edits.before: Zone with chain threat — their carry farms where your E says.
edits.after: A landed Zenith Blade is a kill on her — you dictate every trade.

edits.before: Solar Flare online — dives start from two screens and the sun votes center-stun.
edits.after: Solar Flare locks her down before she can Tidal Wave herself away to disengage.

edits.before: First item: the chain hardens and every landed E is a kill.
edits.after: Your CC still converts kills faster than her sustain saves her.

edits.before: Late Leona starts everything: flare the entry, chain the carry, eclipse the answer.
edits.after: Her heal-bounce and Tidal Wave disengage let her kite mistimed engages, swinging it back.

edits.before: - Nami Aqua Prison: matchup-defining — The bubble starts every Nami play — sidestep it and her kit is small numbers. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Eclipse banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Aqua Prison (Q) is 12-8s — sidestep it and her kit is small numbers, the duo's tempo bends around it. - Keep W Eclipse banked for her 120/110/100s Tidal Wave. - Ebb and Flow (W) is a 10s heal-poke; anti-heal blunts it in extended trades.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Chain the carry the instant Aqua Prison whiffs — engage trades are all-or-nothing here, pick the all.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Engaging into a banked Tidal Wave — the chain that starts answered donates a stun for nothing.
